diagnostic_sources.phase:
extends LearnedBipedMotion

var stop_phase: float = -1.0
var _pending_stop: bool = false
var ramp_seconds: float = 0.0
var settle_seconds: float = 0.0
var _was_moving: bool = false
var _stop_elapsed: float = -1.0
var _stop_action := PackedFloat64Array([0, 0, 0, 0])

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not _enabled or not is_instance_valid(_hardware) or not _hardware.is_built():
		return
	if _was_moving and _move_input.y < 0.05:
		_pending_stop = true
	if _pending_stop:
		var phase: float = fmod(float(_control_step) * float(policy.gait_hz) / CONTROL_HZ, 1.0)
		var distance: float = fmod(phase - stop_phase + 1.0, 1.0)
		if stop_phase >= 0.0 and distance > float(policy.gait_hz) / CONTROL_HZ * 1.1:
			var actual_input: Vector2 = _move_input
			_move_input = Vector2(0, 1)
			super._physics_process(delta)
			_move_input = actual_input
			return
		_pending_stop = false
		_stop_elapsed = 0.0
		_stop_action = _previous_action.duplicate()
		_was_moving = false
	if _stop_elapsed >= 0.0 and _stop_elapsed < ramp_seconds + settle_seconds:
		var strength: float = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, ramp_seconds, _stop_elapsed) if ramp_seconds > 0.0 else 0.0
		var action := _stop_action.duplicate()
		for index: int in ACTIONS:
			action[index] *= strength
		apply_action(action)
		_control_step = 0
		_physics_frame = 0
		_stop_elapsed += delta
		return
	_stop_elapsed = -1.0
	_was_moving = _move_input.y >= 0.05
	super._physics_process(delta)
